output.answer: As of 11 November 2026, Hermès’ latest annual report is included in its 2025 Universal Registration Document (2025 URD). Find it on Hermès Finance’s [Regulated information page](https://finance.hermes.com/en/regulated-information/) under the document dated 19 March 2026, or open the [official English PDF](https://assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391712/260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf?VersionId=jE9NgndClrtsqa.kJW0uyG8NRg4SFCVU). Hermès says the URD includes the 2025 Annual Financial Report and is also available via Investors → Publications → Regulated information.
caveats: The 2026 Half-year Financial Report is newer, but it is not an annual report; the latest annual report remains the 2025 Annual Financial Report included in the 2025 URD.

passages.quote: 2025 Universal Registration Document (2025 URD, including the annual financial report) (e-accessible)
Hermès International filed its 2025 Universal Registration Document with the Financial Markets Authority (AMF), on 19 March 2026, in ESEF format.
It is available to the public under current regulatory conditions and may be found on finance.hermes.com (under “Investors section” > “Publications” and “Regulated information”)
In accordance with the provisions of Article 222-3 of the General Regulation of the Financial Markets Authority (AMF), the Universal Registration Document includes the 2025 Annual Financial Report.
